title: No ads, plenty of reviews
lede: Clearly Canadian did not advertise Orbitz on television; it relied on sampling and events.[^4] What survives on video is the parent brand’s advertising, a fan’s look at the drink, the 1997 website, and later tastings and retrospectives.
